svg.title: code never leaves the machine
svg.desc: With the default local embedding provider, code and indexes stay on the machine. Cloud embeddings are optional; if you select one, code chunks are sent to that provider. Docker, a GPU, and an API key are not required.

text.font-family: Segoe Print, Comic Sans MS, Chalkboard SE, cursive
Segoe Print, Comic Sans MS, Chalkboard SE, cursive

svg.text: Code and indexes stay on the machine with the default local embedding provider.
